Author: Crimson
Name: NIRÆ Tailor
Description: Pick an outfit someone is wearing and port it: from NIRÆ to your FluxHD2 Lalafell (with the outfit's own physics bones), from another body (Bibo+, Rue+, NeoLithe, YAB, Omoi ...) or the game's own gear to NIRÆ with every build, chest, belly and hips option and the body's jiggles, or from another body straight to your Lalafell (through NIRÆ). Makes its own Penumbra mod with a Shown / Removed switch for every clothing piece and the outfit's own options, enables it in the collection you pick and redraws. /tailor
Punchline: Port outfits to NIRÆ and to your Lalafell.
